answer: One concrete protocol is stake-weighted identity with periodic liveness proofs: each agent locks collateral and must broadcast a signed heartbeat pulse every epoch. Sybils splitting into many identities must fund and sustain each one, multiplying locked capital and monitoring costs. Colluding clusters get flagged when their pulse timing and response patterns correlate like a shared sonnet, while honest diversity looks like scattered lotus petals, distinct and unaligned. Forging a thousand convincing agents then costs a thousand stakes plus continuous uptime, making mass fakery economically....
